prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good first place to try is **World Martial Arts Academy**, at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd.** It offers children’s classes, including a program for ages **6–10** (and classes for younger children), with a focus on confidence, focus, and discipline. Its site lists tuition at **$159/month** and says there’s no long-term contract; confirm current pricing and class times directly. [Website](https://blackbeltstl.com/)

If your child is more interested in grappling and practical self-defense, **Onyx Grappling** is another option: **953 Jungermann Road**, with kids’ Brazilian jiu-jitsu classes grouped by age. [Website](https://onyxgrappling.com/)

I’d visit or take a trial class at both before deciding. Watch how instructors manage the kids, whether beginners feel included, and how clearly they explain safety and sparring.
